title: Explicit relative tensor stalk bound for a strictly perfect local model
statement: Let $X,Y$ be schemes [def-pc-scheme], $f:X\to Y$ any morphism, $K$ a complex of $\mathcal O_X$-modules, $V\subseteq X$ open, and $L$ a strictly perfect complex of $\mathcal O_V$-modules [def-pc-perfect-complex]. Assume the restriction of $QK$ to $V$ is isomorphic to $QL$ in $D(\mathcal O_V)$ [def-pc-derived-category]. Let $r,s\in\mathbf Z$ be such that $L^t=0$ for $t<r$ or $s<t$, with no order hypothesis on $r,s$. Fix $y\in V$ and $d\geq0$, and suppose $\operatorname{Tor}^{\mathcal O_{Y,f(y)}}_j(\mathcal O_{X,y},M)=0$ for every module $M$ and every $j>d$, using the actual stalk map. Let $P$ be a K-flat complex of $f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y$-modules [def-pc-kflat-complex] and $q:P\to K$ restricted along $f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y\to\mathcal O_X$ a quasi-isomorphism [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules]. For every $f^{-1}\mathcal O_Y$-module sheaf $F$ and every $i<r-d$ or $s<i$, the underlying abelian-group stalk at $y$ of $H^i(\operatorname{Tot}(P\otimes F[0]))$ [def-pc-tensor-complex-sheaves] is zero. Derived categories of the global and open-restriction module categories are assumed available.

source.place: Tag 0B6G, lemma-perfect-proper-perfect-direct-image, verification of condition (3); Cohomology Tags 08CG, 09U9, 06YB; More on Algebra Tag 064L; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0B6G

proof.text: Take the stalk of each retraction exhibiting a term of L as a direct summand of a finite free structure module. Scalar restriction preserves those retractions. Additivity and retract invariance of Tor give amplitude [-d,0] for each restricted term. The finite filtration of L by degree has successive quotients its terms in their original degrees t, of amplitude [t-d,t]. The long exact cohomology sequence of derived tensor and induction over the nonzero degrees give amplitude [r-d,s]. If r>s, every term is zero and the conclusion holds in every degree.

source.place: Tag 0B6G, lemma-perfect-proper-perfect-direct-image, verification of condition (3); Cohomology Tags 08CG, 09U9, 06YB; More on Algebra Tag 064L; https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/0B6G

proof.text: Because y lies in V, exact restriction and stalks send the representative isomorphism to an isomorphism between the stalk derived objects of K and L. Apply the K-flat stalk criterion to the ringed space with ring sheaf f inverse image O_Y. The given quasi-isomorphism identifies the K-flat stalk of P with the scalar-restricted stalk of K. A common K-flat replacement of the local model, and K-flat tensor quasi-isomorphism invariance transported from the one-point-site module presentation, identify their derived tensor homology. Exactness of stalks and the stalk-total-tensor isomorphism identify this with the displayed abelian-group stalk. The amplitude from the first step gives its vanishing.

theorem strictlyPerfect_relativeTensor_stalk_bound
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} (f : X ⟶ Y)
    [HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))]
    [∀ U : X.Opens,
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U))]
    (K : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)) ℤ)
    (V : X.Opens)
    (L : CochainComplex
      (SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V)) ℤ)
    (hL : IsStrictlyPerfect X V L)
    (eL : Nonempty ((SheafOfModules.overFunctor.{u}
      (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) V).mapDerivedCategory.obj
        (DerivedCategory.Q.obj K) ≅ DerivedCategory.Q.obj L))
    (r s : ℤ) (hdegrees : ∀ t : ℤ, t < r ∨ s < t → IsZero (L.X t))
    (y : X) (hy : y ∈ V) (d : ℕ)
    (hTor : ∀ M : ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk (f y)),
      ∀ j : ℕ, d < j →
        IsZero (((Tor' (ModuleCat.{u} (Y.presheaf.stalk (f y))) j).obj
          ((ModuleCat.restrictScalars (f.stalkMap y).hom).obj
            (ModuleCat.of (X.presheaf.stalk y) (X.presheaf.stalk y)))).obj M))
    (P : CochainComplex (SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose
      (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj
        (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageRing f.base Y.sheaf))) ℤ)
    (hP : CochainComplex.IsKFlat (R := TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageRing f.base Y.sheaf) P)
    (q : P ⟶ ((SheafOfModules.restrictScalars
      ((sheafCompose (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).map
          (Modules.tensorPullbackRingMap f))).mapHomologicalComplex
            (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj K) (hq : QuasiIso q) :
    ∀ F : SheafOfModules.{u} ((sheafCompose
          (Opens.grothendieckTopology X)
          (forget₂ CommRingCat.{u} RingCat.{u})).obj
            (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageRing f.base Y.sheaf)),
        ∀ i : ℤ, i < r - (d : ℤ) ∨ s < i →
          IsZero ((TopCat.Sheaf.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u} X.carrier ⋙
            TopCat.Presheaf.stalkFunctor AddCommGrpCat.{u} y).obj
              ((SheafOfModules.toSheaf _).obj
                ((CochainComplex.mapBifunctor P
                  ((HomologicalComplex.single _ (ComplexShape.up ℤ) 0).obj F)
                  (@MonoidalCategory.curriedTensor _ _ (SheafOfModules.monoidalCategory
                    (TopCat.Sheaf.inverseImageRing f.base Y.sheaf)))).homology i)))
